SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The registry track names two selfHelpStopConditions: 'The county attorney opposes the application.' and 'A disputed intervening conviction inside the two-year window.' The second reaches the participant: 'Check both against your own court record before you sign... If either is not true of your case, this is the wrong packet, and you should stop and talk to a lawyer.' The first reaches nobody. Neither delivered document has a stop-and-get-help section, and the only sentence touching opposition is filing-instructions.md 'After filing': 'The county attorney has an opportunity to respond.' A self-represented filer is told a response may come and is never told that opposition is where this packet's help ends. Sibling Illinois families in this same cohort carry an explicit '## Stop and get help' section; this one carries none.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Registry destination: 'Clerk of the Iowa District Court for the county of the case. File in the case where expungement is sought.' filing-instructions.md: 'File the application in the Iowa District Court for the county shown in the caption on page 1 - the county where the criminal case was handled - under the case number shown beside it', and step 6 names the clerk of court's office for that county. Matches the record.

SERVICE.detail: Registry: eFiling serves the county attorney automatically; paper filers complete the certification and mail or hand deliver a copy. filing-instructions.md steps 5 and 6 say exactly that, including 'the system serves the county attorney for you and you do not need the certification of service', and instruct the filer to complete the certification only after the copy is actually sent.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: Checked line by line against packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling (5 lines). Signature-under-perjury with the A/B election: delivered. Confirmation of the item-1 conviction: delivered as 'Check both against your own court record before you sign.' Filing fee: filing-instructions.md 'Fees and orders' says 'The held source establishes no filing fee for this application and carries no proposed order. Nothing in this packet states an amount' - an honest report of an absence, not a claim that no fee exists. Fee waiver: the record's own line is 'Not applicable while no fee is identified. Unresolved', which carries nothing for a participant to act on. The one line only partly delivered is the digitized-signature permission, and the delivered form prints that footnote itself on page 2. No empty quotation is presented as the record speaking.

observations: The A/B election is left to the filer, yet the self-represented block on page 2 is fully drafted (name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone, email) and the attorney block is refused on every field. The packet therefore prepares for self-representation without asserting it. The guide discloses this; it is not scored as a defect, but a reader may find the two statements in tension.

The record's requiredBeforeFiling line 2 names section 123.47(3) specifically; the form's own printed item 1 and the guide both say 'Iowa Code section 123.47'. The wording is the court's, not the builder's.

counterEvidence.visualDefects: 20 check boxes print with a doubled or misregistered border that the Illinois Supreme Court's own form does not print. Structural cause read from the delivered bytes: flatten() stamped 91 FlatWidget appearance XObjects whose entire stream is a black stroked rectangle at the widget /Rect - '0 0 0 RG / 0 w / 0 0 m / 0 12.113 l / 12.0867 12.113 l / 12.0867 0 l / h / S' - one for every unchecked check box in the packet. 71 of the 91 land on top of the form's own printed box and add no visible mark; 20 are misregistered enough to print a separate hairline, confirmed by directional raster diff against the blank sources at 300 dpi: Request p3 x4 (right edges of the 6ab and 9ab widget pairs), p4 x1 (item 12 Yes), p5 x5, p6 x1, FW-CIV p1 x1, p2 x1, p3 x7. The FIX80 scanner reports this family clean because its predicate requires /MK /BC, and all 94 check-box widgets across the four Illinois sources carry /MK /BC = null; pdf-lib strokes black regardless. That is the structural-versus-raster disagreement resolved from the bytes.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The registry track names eight selfHelpStopConditions. The delivered '## Stop and get help' section carries four: objection by the State's Attorney, ISP, arresting agency or chief legal officer; a contested hearing; eligibility facts that do not match; and immigration consequences. Four are absent from the delivered guide: 'A case appears on the transcript that the participant does not recognize, which may indicate identity theft'; 'The participant has federal or out-of-state records, which an Illinois court cannot reach'; 'A motion to vacate, modify or reconsider is filed under 5.2(d)(12)'; and 'The petition is denied'. The denial case and the out-of-state case are the two a self-represented filer is least able to handle unaided, and the record names both.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Registry destination: 'Circuit clerk of the county of arrest or charge. File with the circuit clerk in each county where an arrest occurred or a charge was brought.' The guide says exactly that, adds the Cook County district instruction and the AOIC flattening requirement.

SERVICE.detail: The guide names the actor (the circuit clerk, 5.2(d)(4)), the recipients (State's Attorney or prosecutor, Illinois State Police, arresting agency, chief legal officer for ordinance violations), the 60-day objection window under 5.2(d)(5)(B), and states plainly that the participant serves nobody.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The ten record lines are present verbatim - all 10 of 10 confirmed by exact string containment against packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling, so FIX13 holds and the ISP statewide criminal history transcript is now named as a fingerprint-based document to obtain. The failure is what the same section then adds. Under 'Every item this packet leaves for you' and the sentence 'Do not sign until the packet is complete', the guide prints eleven further pre-filing obligations: 'Complete arrest60 on EXP-AD Case List page 1' through 'Complete arrest70'. production-field-map.json classifies Case List slots arrest2 through arrest59 as OPTIONAL_PARTICIPANT_CONTENT ('Unused additional-record slot ... every unused row remains wholly blank') and the eleven identical slots arrest60 through arrest70 as REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with requiredBeforeFiling: true. They are the same kind of slot on the same 70-row table. A petitioner with one case is told to complete eleven rows that nothing requires, named by raw AcroForm field ids they cannot interpret. Measured on the delivered guide, not on the ledger.

Recorded as an observation rather than a failure: the same registry track carries a release blocker reading 'a county fee table must be built before a fee figure is shown to a participant', and the guide shows '$60 to $235; McLean County publishes $136' because packetSet.requiredBeforeFiling itself contains that sentence. The record speaks with two voices here. buildBlockers is empty and this is a release gate, not a build gate, so it is routed to the integrator rather than scored.

observations: 46 blank fee-waiver elections are classified in the refusal ledger as participant elections but never reach the participant guide, which lists 58 dollar-amount blanks on the same form and none of the check boxes beside them. Among the omitted are Section 1A 'I am completing this form: for myself / on behalf of a minor', all five Section 3 public-benefit boxes, and the page-2 STOP routing that decides whether the filer qualifies for a full waiver under 735 ILCS 5/5-105(a)(2)(i), (b)(1). A filer following the guide would enter amounts beside unchecked boxes.

No obligation among the fifteen names 'ink the official form does not print'. The 20 synthesized widget borders are therefore carried in the visualDefects counter with their evidence rather than forced into CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP, which they do not fit: nothing is clipped and nothing overlaps printed ink.
